presented_options.D: each statement is implicitly wrapped in its own transaction that commits on success, matching BEGIN/COMMIT semantics

answers.rationale: When not in a transaction, apply_ops calls append_tx which wraps ops in a begin/commit WAL sequence and flushes, committing immediately.

answers.rationale: The WAL is an append-only log; on startup, StorageEngine::open calls wal.replay() to re-apply committed transactions, then truncates the WAL.

answers.rationale: Each WAL record carries a CRC32 hash; replay stops when a record's CRC verification fails (replay breaks at line 117).

presented_options.A: an error at startup demanding manual recovery before any SELECT can run
presented_options.B: all three rows — every fsynced WAL record is replayed on startup

presented_options.D: the two earliest rows — only WAL records that survive the CRC check are replayed; the trailing one is dropped

answers.rationale: Replay only adds ops to a transaction when a Begin record precedes them and a Commit record follows; without Commit, the uncommitted prefix is discarded.
